# ======================================================
# ULTIMATE HARD CORE OOO STRESS TEST
# ONLY: R-type, I-type, LUI, AUIPC, JAL, JALR
# NO BRANCH, NO LOAD/STORE
# ======================================================

# PHASE 1: RENAME EXPLOSION (R + I type mix)
addi  x1, x0, 1      # I-type: x1 = 1
add   x2, x1, x0     # R-type: x2 = 1
addi  x3, x2, 3      # I-type: x3 = 4
add   x1, x3, x2     # R-type: x1 = 5
addi  x2, x1, 5      # I-type: x2 = 10
add   x3, x2, x1     # R-type: x3 = 15
addi  x1, x3, 7      # I-type: x1 = 22
add   x2, x1, x3     # R-type: x2 = 37
addi  x3, x2, 9      # I-type: x3 = 46
add   x1, x3, x2     # R-type: x1 = 83

# PHASE 2: LUI + AUIPC (upper immediate instructions)
lui   x4, 0x12345    # LUI: x4 = 0x12345000
auipc x5, 0x67890    # AUIPC: x5 = PC + 0x67890000
addi  x6, x4, 0x678  # I-type: x6 = 0x12345678
add   x7, x5, x6     # R-type: x7 = PC + 0x67890000 + 0x12345678
lui   x8, 0xFFFFF    # LUI: x8 = 0xFFFFF000
addi  x9, x8, 0xFF  # I-type: x9 = 0xFFFFFFFF (-1)
auipc x10, 0x00001   # AUIPC: x10 = PC + 0x1000
lui   x11, 0x00001   # LUI: x11 = 0x1000
add   x12, x10, x11  # R-type: x12 = PC + 0x1000 + 0x1000

# PHASE 3: JAL + JALR (jump instructions - no branch)
jal   x13, 0x40      # JAL: x13 = PC+4, jump to PC+0x40
addi  x14, x0, 1     # Should execute after jump
addi  x15, x0, 2     
addi  x16, x0, 3     
addi  x17, x0, 4     # Target of jump
#jalr  x18, x13, 0    # JALR: x18 = PC+4, jump back to x13
addi  x19, x0, 5     # Should execute after return
addi  x20, x0, 6
addi  x21, x0, 7     # Back here

# PHASE 4: DEPENDENCY TORNADO (all types interleaved)
# R-type chain
add   x22, x0, x0    # x22 = 0
addi  x23, x22, 10   # x23 = 10
add   x24, x23, x22  # x24 = 10
addi  x25, x24, 20   # x25 = 30
add   x26, x25, x23  # x26 = 40

# LUI + AUIPC chain
lui   x27, 0x10000   # x27 = 0x10000000
auipc x28, 0x20000   # x28 = PC + 0x20000000
add   x29, x27, x28  # x29 = 0x10000000 + PC + 0x20000000
addi  x30, x29, 100  # x30 = x29 + 100
lui   x31, 0x00001   # x31 = 0x1000
add   x1, x30, x31   # x1 = x29 + 100 + 0x1000

# PHASE 5: ALL TYPES MIXED (maximum rename pressure)
lui   x2, 0xAAAAA    # LUI: x2 = 0xAAAAA000
auipc x3, 0xBBBBB    # AUIPC: x3 = PC + 0xBBBBB000
addi  x4, x2, 0x555  # I-type: x4 = 0xAAAAA555
add   x5, x3, x4     # R-type: x5 = PC + 0xBBBBB000 + 0xAAAAA555
jal   x6, 0x30       # JAL: x6 = PC+4
addi  x7, x0, 100    # after JAL target
addi  x8, x0, 200
addi  x9, x0, 300
#jalr  x10, x6, 0     # JALR: x10 = PC+4 return
addi  x11, x0, 400   # after return
lui   x12, 0xCCCCC   # LUI: x12 = 0xCCCCC000
auipc x13, 0xDDDDD   # AUIPC: x13 = PC + 0xDDDDD000
add   x14, x12, x13  # R-type: x14 = 0xCCCCC000 + PC + 0xDDDDD000
addi  x15, x14, 500  # I-type: x15 = x14 + 500

# PHASE 6: WAW + WAR with ALL types (rename test)
lui   x16, 0x11111   # x16 = 0x11111000
addi  x16, x16, 0x88 # x16 = 0x11111888 (WAW)
auipc x16, 0x00000   # x16 = PC (WAW again)
add   x17, x16, x0   # x17 = PC (RAW on x16)
lui   x16, 0xFFFFF   # x16 = 0xFFFFF000 (WAR on x17? No, separate)
addi  x18, x16, 0xFF # x18 = -1
auipc x19, 0x00001   # x19 = PC + 0x1000
add   x20, x19, x16  # x20 = PC + 0x1000 + 0xFFFFF000

# PHASE 7: JAL/JALR chain (function call simulation - no branch)
jal   x21, 0x50      # call func1
addi  x22, x0, 1     # return here (x22 = 1)
jal   x23, 0x60      # call func2
addi  x24, x0, 2     # return here (x24 = 2)
jal   x25, 0x70      # call func3
addi  x26, x0, 3     # return here (x26 = 3)
jal   x0, 0x80       # jump to end (unconditional)

# func1: (address 0x50)
addi  x27, x0, 10
addi  x28, x0, 20
#jalr  x0, x21, 0     # return

# func2: (address 0x60)
lui   x29, 0x10000
auipc x30, 0x20000
#jalr  x0, x23, 0     # return

# func3: (address 0x70)
add   x31, x27, x28  # x31 = 30
addi  x1, x31, 40    # x1 = 70
#jalr  x0, x25, 0     # return

# end: (address 0x80)
nop
nop

# PHASE 8: ALU PIPELINE HAZARD (burst same ALU op)
add   x2, x0, x0     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     
add   x2, x2, x2     # x2 = 65536 (2^16)

# PHASE 9: RANDOM NO-DEPENDENCY BURST (issue width test)
addi  x3, x0, 1
addi  x4, x0, 2
addi  x5, x0, 3
addi  x6, x0, 4
addi  x7, x0, 5
addi  x8, x0, 6
addi  x9, x0, 7
addi  x10, x0, 8
addi  x11, x0, 9
addi  x12, x0, 10
addi  x13, x0, 11
addi  x14, x0, 12
addi  x15, x0, 13
addi  x16, x0, 14
addi  x17, x0, 15
addi  x18, x0, 16
addi  x19, x0, 17
addi  x20, x0, 18
addi  x21, x0, 19
addi  x22, x0, 20
addi  x23, x0, 21
addi  x24, x0, 22
addi  x25, x0, 23
addi  x26, x0, 24
addi  x27, x0, 25
addi  x28, x0, 26
addi  x29, x0, 27
addi  x30, x0, 28
addi  x31, x0, 29
addi  x1, x0, 30
addi  x2, x0, 31

# PHASE 10: FINAL MEGA MIX (all types together)
lui   x3, 0x12345    # LUI
auipc x4, 0x67890    # AUIPC
addi  x5, x3, 0x678  # I-type: x5 = 0x12345678
add   x6, x4, x5     # R-type: x6 = PC + 0x67890000 + 0x12345678
jal   x7, 0x40       # JAL
addi  x8, x0, 1000   # after JAL target
addi  x9, x0, 2000
addi  x10, x0, 300
#jalr  x11, x7, 0     # JALR return
addi  x12, x0, 400  # after return
slt   x13, x12, x8   # R-type: x13 = 0 (4000 < 1000? false)
addi  x14, x13, 1    # I-type: x14 = 1
lui   x15, 0xFFFFF   # LUI: x15 = 0xFFFFF000
auipc x16, 0x00001   # AUIPC: x16 = PC + 0x1000
add   x17, x15, x16  # R-type: final result
sll   x18, x5, x14   # R-type shift: x18 = 0x12345678 << 1 = 0x2468ACF0
srl   x19, x18, x14  # R-type shift: x19 = 0x12345678
xor   x20, x5, x6    # R-type XOR
and   x21, x5, x6    # R-type AND
or    x22, x5, x6    # R-type OR
sub   x23, x6, x5    # R-type SUB
sltu  x24, x8, x12   # R-type: x24 = 1 (1000 < 4000? true)
sra   x25, x15, x14  # R-type arithmetic shift: x25 = 0xFFFFF800

# FINAL: nop padding
nop
nop
nop
nop
